question: What procession must the wise officiant perform before positioning the image?
premises: Circumambulation of the temple is performed.
The wise officiant conducts the action.
The front of the image is then led forward.
inference: Having circumambulated the temple, the wise one should lead the front of the image forward.
uncertainties: 'pratimāgraṃ' may mean the front of the image or the image foremost; context supports leading it forward.
plain_english: Having circumambulated the temple, the wise one should lead the front of the image forward.
